data.description:
## Purpose
Aggregating task: scan the SESSION_1/SESSION_2/SESSION_3 comments on ticket 745a-b46d, confirm the two done definitions for SC6 are met, and write the closing evidence summary.

## Steps
1. Read all SESSION_* comments on 745a-b46d: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 745a-b46d
2. Confirm >=3 sessions were completed with PRECONDITIONS events accessible (done definition 1)
3. Confirm >=1 session recorded meta_question_fired=yes AND user_answer != null with a non-default response (done definition 2)
4. If done definition 2 is not yet met: flag which sessions still need re-running with different epics that are more likely to surface a genuine meta-question (epics with more ambiguous scope or blocking_for chains)
5. If both done definitions are met: write SC6 evidence comment on ticket 745a-b46d

## SC6 evidence comment format
SC6_EVIDENCE: sessions_run=3, sessions_with_preconditions=<count>, meta_question_with_nonnull_answer=<count>, example_session=<epic-id>, example_user_answer=<verbatim or summary>, done_definition_1=met, done_definition_2=met

## Done
- Both done definitions confirmed met
- SC6_EVIDENCE comment written on 745a-b46d
- Story is ready for closure
data.title: Verify >=1 META_QUESTION with non-default user_answer across all sessions and document evidence summary
